subject: phase3_dvc_medium_calibration
statement: Replace the operator-mutated public dependency environment before launch and retain the approved DVC instance, mode order, and paid execution ceilings unchanged.
selected_option: discard the zero-provider-call v1 environment and bind the calibration to the clean v2 environment authority

alternatives.option: accept the mutated v1 dependency tree
alternatives.rejected_reason: Its content no longer matched the frozen authority, so accepting it would defeat fail-closed environment identity.

alternatives.option: recompute the v1 authority over generated bytecode
alternatives.rejected_reason: The bytecode came from an operator probe after extraction and is not part of the pinned image environment.
No provider call or scored execution occurred, and clean rematerialization from the same pinned image restores the frozen boundary.

rationale: Provider-free bundle construction recomputed the public dependency tree and rejected 114 generated pytest bytecode files. A clean extraction from the unchanged digest-pinned image reproduced the original 29211-file, 718828719-byte tree. Only the host source path and therefore the enclosing authority digest changed. This is infrastructure recovery before launch, not an experimental treatment change.
expected_outcome: Use only the clean v2 public dependency authority for provider-free replay and any later model execution.
acceptance_refs: the replacement tree validates immediately before bundle publication
the replacement image digest equals the revision 1 pinned image digest
no provider evidence exists under the discarded partial bundle
all revision 1 task, model, mode-order, and budget fields remain unchanged
